localChanges: Windows can now be moved by dragging their title bar with a finger or a pen as well as a mouse, and a window can no longer be dragged so far off the screen that its title bar is out of reach (closes #858).

If your device is set to reduce motion, the unit awaiting orders is marked with a steady ring instead of blinking, and the map stops where you let go of it instead of gliding on. Choosing Blink in Options still gives you the blink (closes #856).
